answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by running a live uniqueness mirror over submitted work. Each answer is compared against a random panel of recent texts; near-duplicates are rejected on-ledger and slash a posted bond. The panel is sampled like a falcon scanning from a summit, so an attacker cannot predict which neighbors will be checked. Spinning up a thousand fake names then costs a thousand distinct answers plus locked collateral, not one reused paragraph copied across accounts. Cheap clone farms fail the similarity check and lose their deposits.
